data.name: Weakening Touch
data.description: A shade's slam attack causes its victim to take a -2 penalty to Strength for 1 round. As a standard action, a shade in incorporeal form can deliver the penalty as a touch attack. This penalty does not stack with itself. This is a negative energy effect.
